verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say it can 'implement entirely new features' and 'build internal tools' from delegated tasks, and that it can connect to Figma through MCP integrations. Together these suggest a design-to-implementation path, but nothing documents mockup-to-code conversion or a non-engineer completing work without engineering review. missing for 10: documented mockup/design-to-code workflow, evidence that a non-engineer persona can ship without engineering review, hands-on or independent corroboration of design-driven builds.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can go from a mockup or design to a working implementation without an engineering handoff

citations.quote: implement entirely new features, repro and fix bugs, build internal tools, and more!
